stories.headline: AI *Patches* Kernel Vulnerabilities
stories.facts: OpenAI built an autonomous pipeline that successfully found, validated, and generated security patches for 948 local privilege-escalation flaws in the Linux kernel.
stories.caption_line: 🛡️ OpenAI built an autonomous pipeline that discovered, validated, and patched nearly a thousand vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.

In the midground, abstract holographic security shields and cascading green binary data streams hover in the air. A warm orange sunset glow highlights the top edge of the hardware array. No readable text.
stories.source_title: A thousand fewer paths to root

stories.headline: Voters *Reject* New Data Centers
stories.facts: Data center developers face a tougher building environment after voters across the country backed candidates favoring moratoriums and expansion obstacles.
stories.caption_line: 🗳️ Data center developers face a harsher building climate as voters across the US back new moratoriums and expansion hurdles.
stories.image_prompt: A wide photorealistic collage of a sprawling modern data center building under a dramatic stormy sunset sky. In the foreground, glowing holographic warning signs and ballot box icons float above a dark metallic surface. The color palette combines deep electric-blue shadows with a stark warm-orange horizon. No readable text.

stories.headline: Google *Ties* Search to Classrooms
stories.facts: Google plans to turn off AI features in school products by default starting in 2027, and schools that block AI entirely will also lose access to Google Search.
stories.caption_line: 🏫 Google confirmed that schools opting out of its integrated AI tools will lose access to Google Search entirely starting in 2027.
stories.image_prompt: A clean photorealistic tech slide showing a modern student laptop resting on a wooden desk in a softly lit classroom. In the midground, a glowing holographic search bar and warning indicator float above the screen. Studio lighting casts warm orange highlights and cool blue reflections across the scene. No readable text.
stories.source_title: Schools that turn off Google's AI will lose search too starting in 2027

stories.headline: OpenAI *Acquires* Pierre Computer
stories.facts: OpenAI is purchasing startup Pierre Computer Company, whose libraries power the coding agent Codex, to build out infrastructure for developers and AI agents.
stories.caption_line: 🤝 OpenAI is acquiring startup Pierre Computer Company to enhance the Git integration capabilities of its Codex coding agent.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic tech carousel slide featuring a sleek metallic developer terminal interface in the foreground. In the midground, stacks of glowing data nodes and a rising network graph connect multiple workstations. The scene is lit with electric-blue studio rims and warm orange accent lights. No readable text.
stories.source_title: OpenAI acquires Pierre Computer Company to make Git keep up with AI coding agents

stories.headline: ChatGPT *Adds* Animated GIFs
stories.facts: ChatGPT can now create GIFs using text prompts or uploaded photos via the Images 2.6 model, allowing users to adjust animation speed, edit frames, and share them.
stories.caption_line: ✨ ChatGPT can now natively generate animated GIFs from text prompts and photos using the new Images 2.6 model.

In the midground, floating frame-by-frame animation strips and glowing particle streams drift upward. The composition uses dramatic studio rim lighting with an electric-blue and warm-orange palette. No readable text.
stories.source_title: ChatGPT will now make you animated GIFs

stories.headline: Few Users *Book* Rides via Agents
stories.facts: During its busiest week last quarter, Uber reported that only four people booked a ride using an AI agent.
stories.caption_line: 🚗 Uber revealed that during its busiest week last quarter, only four total rides were booked using third-party AI agents.

No readable text.
stories.source_title: Almost no one uses AI agents to book their Uber, company says

caption:
The biggest AI breakthroughs and policy clashes are reshaping tech this week.

1. 🛡️ OpenAI built an autonomous pipeline that discovered, validated, and patched nearly a thousand vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.
2. 🗳️ Data center developers face a harsher building climate as voters across the US back new moratoriums and expansion hurdles.
3. 🏫 Google confirmed that schools opting out of its integrated AI tools will lose access to Google Search entirely starting in 2027.
4. 🤝 OpenAI is acquiring startup Pierre Computer Company to enhance the Git integration capabilities of its Codex coding agent.
5. ✨ ChatGPT can now natively generate animated GIFs from text prompts and photos using the new Images 2.6 model.
6. 🚗 Uber revealed that during its busiest week last quarter, only four total rides were booked using third-party AI agents.
